'''Bakuran fever bumps''' was a condition that originated from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]]. The fever caused numerous small welts to appear on the skin of the afflicted.<ref name="rebirth">''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory II: Rebirth]]''</ref>
